content: पूतनः A dead body in a cemetery. .{@-ना@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a female demon who, while attempting to kill Kṛṣṇa, when but an infant, was herself crushed by him. .²2 A demoness, or Rākṣasī in general; मा पूतनात्वमुपगाः शिवतातिरेधि <ls>Māl. 9. 50</ls>. .²3 Terminalia chebula (हरीतकी); ‘पूतना राक्षसीभेदे हरीतक्यां च पूतना’ <ls>Viśva.</ls>
